rationale: X is at parity overall: it produces a genuinely behavioral shaping brief, covers every requested matching, timing, nesting, payload, exception, cleanup, arity, and long-running-subscription constraint, and avoids choosing an implementation. Focused execution confirmed the central claims with 7 notification tests and 1 regexp-capture test passing, while a separate raising-block probe confirmed publication, exception annotation and identity, re-raising, and post-block cleanup. Its main weaknesses are several inaccurate line links and a less explicit statement of the future usability improvement than R2, neither of which changes the behavior a maintainer would preserve.

shortcomings.summary: Several of X's citations do not point to the claimed evidence in this checkout.
shortcomings.evidence: X.md line 25 cites `notifications.rb` L137-L143 for regexp subscription, but the regexp example is at L144-L150; it cites the guide at L88-L94, but that example is at `guides/source/active_support_instrumentation.md` L74-L80; and it cites `notification_assertions_test.rb` L138-L146 even though the file ends at L114 and the regexp case is at L92-L98. X.md line 14 likewise links the cache warning at L164-L167 although it is at L161-L163.

shortcomings.summary: X leaves the actual usability improvement less explicit in its desired outcomes than R2 does.
shortcomings.evidence: X.md L43-L51 mostly restates existing behavioral contracts and leaves callback ergonomics and guidance as questions at L138-L142; its clearest requirement that authors should not still have to pre-build a callback appears only as a reconsideration signal at L134. R2.md instead makes an obvious block-scoped path and first-class documentation explicit desired outcomes at L69 and L76.

strengths.summary: X preserves the difficult interleaved-handle boundary in unusually direct language.
strengths.evidence: X.md L35, L49, and L102-L104 consistently state that an inner observer attached only around `finish` receives nothing while the outer observer receives the event, exactly matching `activesupport/test/notifications_test.rb` L197-L221.

strengths.summary: X is more concise than the references without dropping a requested section or representative behavior.
strengths.evidence: X.md is 143 lines versus 212 for R1.md and 206 for R2.md, yet it still includes the problem and pain, current behavior, desired outcomes, non-goals, compatibility constraints, exact/regexp/all-event examples, timestamp modes, nested and raising examples, acceptance and failure signals, and open questions.
